fix(docs): a live card's crash is said on the card, not drawn into its terminal (rich-demos-k78j.1cv)

LiveTerminal ends a crashed program in a 'crashed' state carrying the
report; LiveScreen hands every failure to its card through a required
'failed' prop instead of keeping a second failure surface of its own. The
card's one rich-example-failure says it, located by the same crashSaid the
static runs use, and keeps it through an edit that does not parse.

chore(docs): delete the iframe demo shell (rich-demos-k78j.7qo) (#372)

* chore(docs): delete the iframe demo shell; one demo list read off examples/ (rich-demos-k78j.7qo)

Every demo runs in its card, so the vite demo bundle, demos:build, the
generated demos.json, the _browser-shell templates, the browser-terminal-host
harness and the iframe branches of the demo page and e2e spec go. demoNames()
in docs/.vitepress/demo-entry.ts is the one list the sidebar, the demo routes,
the Demos index (demos.data.ts) and the e2e gate read. XTERM moves beside the
live terminal that loads it.

* fix(docs): review — demo list checked, loud when empty, compiler-free; CI builds terminal demos (rich-demos-k78j.7qo)
